slides.title: 5 amenities that can add tens of thousands to your Airbnb.
Fitness amenities.
slides.body: Travelers don't stop training on vacation. A home gym, a rack of dumbbells or a bike gives fitness focused guests a reason to book you over the listing next door.

slides.title: Sleep more, earn more.
slides.body: The more guests you can sleep, the higher your nightly rate. Bunk rooms, quality sleeper sofas and smart layouts turn a 6 guest home into an 8 or 10 guest stay.

slides.title: Build an Instagram moment.
slides.body: A custom mural, a statement wall or a photo ready corner gets guests posting. Every post is free marketing that points straight back to your listing.

slides.title: Lighting changes everything.
slides.body: It's the detail most hosts forget. Warm, layered light makes rooms feel bigger, photos look better, and guests feel at home the second they walk in.

slides.title: Brand it like a hotel.
slides.body: Give your stay a name, a look and a feel. Branded welcome cards, linens and signage make guests remember you, and come back to book direct.

slides.body: Planning a launch or a refresh? Send this to a host who needs it, and follow for more short term rental strategy.
